requirements: R1: The backend Docker container must launch successfully without encountering 'port is already allocated' errors for port 18080.

slices.title: Fix backend container port conflict
slices.jtbd: When implementing the port conflict resolution for this epic, I want to correct the host-to-container port mapping, so that the backend service starts successfully.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the host environment might already have port 18080 allocated
When the docker compose stack is launched
Then the backend container correctly maps to an available host port instead of conflicting
And the system startup completes without networking errors
